metadata.system_name: SYNAPSE Phase 2 Longitudinal Clinical Simulation Pipeline
metadata.architecture: Synthea-Inspired Longitudinal State Machine with Forward Hemodynamics and Survey Protocols

input_sources: Sample Registration System (SRS) 2021 India Census Life Tables
simulation_pipeline_stages.process_description: Initializes 10,000 synthetic patient contexts using stratified sampling across age (5 bands), sex (51.5% male, 48.5% female), state, and baseline health indicators.

Evaluates discrete-time Markovian and semi-Markovian state transitions every 7 days. Computes disease inception, chronic progression, microvascular complications, acute symptom triggers, and background mortality.

input_sources: ICMR Standard Treatment Guidelines (STG) 2022 for Hypertension and Diabetes
simulation_pipeline_stages.process_description: Generates outpatient department (OPD) consultations triggered by acute symptomatic presentation or routine chronic follow-ups. Emits diagnostic observations, first-line and stepped-care prescriptions, and lifestyle care plans.

supported_modes.LEGACY_CONDITIONAL: Default mode. Evaluates age-, sex-, and disease-stratified conditional distributions with medication response offsets.
supported_modes.FORWARD_STATE_SPACE: Experimental opt-in engine. Models continuous arterial compliance, systemic vascular resistance, cardiac output, and autonomic baroreflex dynamics.

simulation_pipeline_stages.stage_name: Triplicate Seated Blood Pressure Community Protocol
simulation_pipeline_stages.process_description: Samples 2,638 surviving older adults (age 45+) at simulation day 360. Conducts 3 sequential seated blood pressure measurements per participant with a 5-minute pre-rest and 2-minute inter-reading intervals, modeling observer variability and initial familiarization effects.
invariants_enforced: Exactly 3 readings per assessment (7,914 total readings)

simulation_pipeline_stages.stage_name: Analytical Dataset Export, Telemetry & Validation Gate
simulation_pipeline_stages.process_description: Serializes in-memory patient histories into 18 standardized tabular CSVs, computes SHA-256 integrity checksums, validates relational integrity, and checks 21 clinical metrics against preregistered criteria.
